metadata.description: An extra pair of hands for your store.

plugins.name: storehand
plugins.description: Open-source skills that turn Claude into your daily Shopify operator. Today: store setup, a daily briefing (orders, payment problems, cancellations, stock alerts), a weekly health check (sold-out products, broken links, discount and metadata gaps), a listing writer that proposes product copy into a file you edit before anything is written, an SEO audit that sweeps the whole catalogue and orders what to fix first, and a weekly report of what changed against the week before. On the way: price watching. Runs through the official Shopify CLI. Read-only by default. Sends no telemetry.
